1479-5700-5701-7893-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5700-5701-7893-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Thranduil trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Thranduil triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Thranduil triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1479-5700-5701-7892-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5700-5701-7892-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Thranduil the Strategist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Thranduil the Strategist triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

3967-5254-6627.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
3967-5254-6627.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, Repeat.

728-2523-2869.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
728-2523-2869.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of the creature that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1887-2021-2060-2313.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

1368-1849-6321-6723.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1849-6321-6723.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

757-1606-5904.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

11-2575-6555-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-2575-6555-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Temporal Mastery by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Temporal Mastery.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Temporal Mastery spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Temporal Mastery spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Temporal Mastery and returning the original Temporal Mastery to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Temporal Mastery from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

436-4089-5220.description:
Cast Glasspool Mimic by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Put Glasspool Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Glasspool Mimic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put Glasspool Mimic onto the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Repeat from step 2.

1477-2866-4211-4986.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

586-2511-3375-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2661-3692.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Aethersnipe for its evoke cost by paying {1}{U}{U}.
Gwenna and Birgi trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Gwenna trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
When Aethersnipe enters the battlefield, its first ability and evoke ability trigger.
Resolve the first Aethersnipe trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Aethersnipe trigger, failing to sacrifice it as it is no longer on the battlefield.
Repeat.

2043-2092-4715.description:
Activate Urza by paying {1}, creating a token copy of Prized Statue that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Prized Statue token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3054-4050-6026.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
3054-4050-6026.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Field of Souls triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

277-5531-5732-6620.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Port of Karfell can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
277-5531-5732-6620.description:
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing a land other than Port of Karfell.
Repeat step 2 until you control no other lands except Port of Karfell.
Activate Port of Karfell's second ability by paying {3}{U}{B}{B}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to mill four cards and return Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Lumra enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

3967-5968-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
3967-5968-5972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

647-2457-3129-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

939-1636-4336-4694.notablePrerequisites:
Soul Foundry does not have summoning sickness.
Kobolds of Kher Keep exiled by Soul Foundry.
939-1636-4336-4694.description:
Activate Soul Foundry by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Kobolds of Kher Keep
When the Kobolds of Kher Keep token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1744-2699-3096-3994.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two other Golems on the battlefield.
1744-2699-3096-3994.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, targeting Precursor Golem.
Precursor Golem's second ability triggers, creating a kicked copy of Rite of Replication targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Rite of Replication, creating five token copies of the Golem it is targeting.
If the Golem was Percursor Golem, the Percursor Golem tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their first abilities, creating a total of ten 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3 for each other Rite of Replication.
Cast Aggressive Urge by paying {G}, targeting any Golem.
The six Percursor Golems' second abilities each trigger, creating six copies of Aggressive Urge targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Aggressive Urge, giving target creature +1/+1 and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat step 8 until you draw from an empty library, causing you to win the game.

224-1525-4677-4913.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-1525-4677-4913.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand, then put the land onto the battlefield tapped, and repeat this process once if you control at least eight lands.
Retreat to Coralhelm and Zendikar's Roil trigger for each land that enters the battlefield this way.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger(s), untapping Zimone and Dina.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger(s), creating that many creature tokens.
Repeat.

3537-3746-4170-4747.notablePrerequisites:
Robaran Mercenaries does not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater that entered the battlefield this turn.
3537-3746-4170-4747.description:
Activate Robaran Mercenaries using Alena's ability by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Bog Initiate by paying {1}, adding {B}.
Activate Robaran Mercenaries using Fain's fourth ability by paying {3}{B}, untapping Robaran Mercenaries.
Repeat.

878-2942-3059.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Ziatora triggers, causing you to sacrifice Malignus, deal damage equal to three times Malignus's power to target opponent, and create three Treasure tokens.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1750-2575-4861-5261.description:
Cast Temporal Mastery by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile Temporal Mastery.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Temporal Mastery into your graveyard from exile.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Temporal Mastery from your graveyard by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile Temporal Mastery.
Repeat from step 2.

981-1517-2104-3505.notablePrerequisites: The Mirari Conjecture has two lore counters on it.
981-1517-2104-3505.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Mirari Conjecture triggers, putting a lore counter on itself, sacrificing itself and copying all instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}.
The Mirari Conjecture triggers, creating a copy of Temporal Manipulation.
Resolve both Temporal Manipulations, getting two extra turns after this one.
Cast Second Sunrise by paying {1}{W}{W}.
The Mirari Conjecture triggers, copying Second Sunrise.
Holding priority, activate Cursecatcher by sacrificing it, countering the original Second Sunrise.
Resolve the Second Sunrise copy, returning The Mirari Conjecture and Cursecatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
The Mirari Conjecture triggers, putting a lore counter on itself and returning Second Sunrise from your graveyard to your hand.
Proceed to your next turn.
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Mirari Conjecture triggers, putting a lore counter on itself and returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Proceed to your next turn.
Repeat.
